shared_elements: tall stone slab with rounded/domed top
low-relief carving on a single face
horizontal registers divided by incised lines
a band of small repeated motifs across the upper field
bird-like / winged motif near the top
human or humanoid figures with raised arms
justification: Both are round-topped stone slabs whose single carved face is organised into stacked horizontal registers, each opening with a crowning motif at the summit followed by a narrow band of small repeated elements and then figural rows mixing profile animals with human figures — a genuinely comparable compositional scheme. The manner of execution differs sharply, however: A uses few, large, boldly modelled figures in raised, rounded relief with much blank ground, while B packs dozens of tiny, flat, finely incised figures and sign-like marks densely into every register.
